title: The Khalsa Marches on Kasur Under Favorable Hukam

blocks.text: The favorable hukam transforms hesitation into joy. Taking the divine indication as assurance, Khalsa march did he order early in the morning, and the expedition begins with the confidence of a force that believes victory has already been announced in principle.

Hari Singh then widens the call beyond his immediate camp. Hari Singh sent dispatches to the Singhs all around so that anyone eager to uphold the Panth's honor and defend the oppressed could join the march on Kasur.

The page tracks this early mobilization through successive halts and gathering points as more misl strength accumulates. What began as one Brahmin's appeal has now become a multi-contingent Khalsa campaign.
